title: Suspend and resume of the N1 NAS signalling connection

entities.name: Suspend and resume of N1 NAS signalling connection
entities.description: Procedure for suspending and resuming the N1 NAS signalling connection when user plane CIoT 5GS optimization is used. Initiated by network for suspend and by UE for resume.

entities.name: 5GMM-CONNECTED mode
entities.description: State where UE has an active NAS signalling connection with the network.

entities.name: 5GMM-IDLE mode with suspend indication
entities.description: State where UE is in idle mode but N1 NAS signalling connection is suspended rather than released.

entities.name: 5GMM-IDLE mode without suspend indication
entities.description: Normal idle state where N1 NAS signalling connection is released.

entities.name: REGISTRATION REQUEST message
entities.description: Initial NAS message used for registration procedure.

entities.name: SERVICE REQUEST message
entities.description: Initial NAS message used for service request procedure.

entities.name: CONTROL PLANE SERVICE REQUEST message
entities.description: Initial NAS message used for control plane service request procedure.

entities.name: 5GS update type IE
entities.description: Information element containing update type information including NG-RAN-RCU bit.

entities.name: NAS message container IE
entities.description: Information element containing encapsulated NAS messages.

entities.name: CIoT small data container IE
entities.description: Information element containing small data for CIoT optimization.

entities.name: UE radio capability update needed
entities.description: Condition where NG-RAN-RCU bit of 5GS update type IE is set to indicate UE radio capability update is needed.

entities.name: RRC connection resumed
entities.description: Condition where lower layers indicate RRC connection has been successfully resumed.

entities.name: RRC connection resume failed
entities.description: Condition where lower layers indicate RRC connection resume has failed.

entities.name: Cipher NAS message
entities.description: Property indicating NAS message should be ciphered before transmission as specified in subclause 4.4.5.

relations.description: Suspend procedure requires UE to be in 5GMM-CONNECTED mode.
Suspend procedure establishes 5GMM-IDLE mode with suspend indication.
REGISTRATION REQUEST message contains 5GS update type IE.
5GS update type IE guards by NG-RAN-RCU bit condition for UE radio capability update.
UE radio capability update needed condition establishes transition to 5GMM-IDLE mode without suspend indication.
RRC connection resumed condition establishes transition to 5GMM-CONNECTED mode.
RRC connection resumed condition establishes requirement to cipher NAS message.
SERVICE REQUEST message may contain NAS message container IE.
CONTROL PLANE SERVICE REQUEST message may contain CIoT small data container IE.
CONTROL PLANE SERVICE REQUEST message may contain NAS message container IE.
RRC connection resume failed with suspension indication establishes 5GMM-IDLE mode with suspend indication.
RRC connection resume failed without suspension indication establishes 5GMM-IDLE mode without suspend indication.
